# Instructions

Generate the lyrics of the song 'I Know an Old Lady Who Swallowed a Fly'.

While you could copy/paste the lyrics, or read them from a file, this problem is much more interesting if you approach it algorithmically.

This is a [cumulative song][cumulative-song] of unknown origin.

This is one of many common variants.

```text
I know an old lady who swallowed a fly.
I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.

It wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her.
She swallowed the spider to catch the fly.
I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.

How absurd to swallow a bird!

She swallowed the spider to catch the fly.
I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.

Just opened her throat and swallowed a goat!

She swallowed the spider to catch the fly.
I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.

I don't know how she swallowed a cow!
She swallowed the cow to catch the goat.
She swallowed the goat to catch the dog.
She swallowed the dog to catch the cat.
She swallowed the cat to catch the bird.
She swallowed the bird to catch the spider that wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her.
She swallowed the spider to catch the fly.
I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.

I know an old lady who swallowed a horse.
She's dead, of course!
```

{"new_string":"_ANIMALS = ("fly", "spider", "bird", "cat", "dog", "goat", "cow", "horse")
_SPIDER_DESCRIPTION = "wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her"
_REMARKS = (
    "",
    f"It {_SPIDER_DESCRIPTION}.",
    "How absurd to swallow a bird!",
    "Imagine that, to swallow a cat!",
    "What a hog, to swallow a dog!",
    "Just opened her throat and swallowed a goat!",
    "I don't know how she swallowed a cow!",
    "She's dead, of course!",
)
_REFRAIN = "I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die."


def recite(start_verse, end_verse):
    """Return lines of the inclusive, one-based verse range."""
    lines = []
    for verse in range(start_verse - 1, end_verse):
        if lines:
            lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"I know an old lady who swallowed a {_ANIMALS[verse]}.")
        if _REMARKS[verse]:
            lines.append(_REMARKS[verse])
        if verse == len(_ANIMALS) - 1:
            continue

        for predator in range(verse, 0, -1):
            prey = _ANIMALS[predator - 1]
            if prey == "spider":
                prey += f" that {_SPIDER_DESCRIPTION}"
            lines.append(
                f"She swallowed the {_ANIMALS[predator]} to catch the {prey}."
            )
        lines.append(_REFRAIN)
    return lines

class FoodChainTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_full_song(self):
        self.assertEqual(recite(1, 8), EXPECTED_SONG.splitlines())

    def test_every_inclusive_verse_range(self):
        verses = EXPECTED_SONG.split("\n\n")
        for start in range(1, 9):
            for end in range(start, 9):
                with self.subTest(start=start, end=end):
                    expected = "\n\n".join(verses[start - 1:end]).splitlines()
                    self.assertEqual(recite(start, end), expected)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
